## Problem

> [!TIP]
> Describe the current problem, challenge or risk in concrete terms.
> **Ask:**
> _"What is the problem, that needs to be solved?"_

## Solution

> [!TIP]
> Describe the proposed approach, including important constraints.
> **Ask:**
> _"How do you imagine solving this problem?"_

## Value

> [!TIP]
> Explain why the outcome of the solution matters now for sponsors, maintainers, and users.
> **Ask:**
> _"What are you hoping to achieve?"_

## Deliverables

- [ ] Deliverable 1
- [ ] Deliverable 2

## Discussion

> [!TIP]
> **Optional section/header**
> If relevant, clarify if you need specific input, feedback, perspective.
> Add helpful references, background articles etc.

## Acceptance criteria

> [!TIP]
> **Optional section/header**
> I relevant add a list of simple
>
> Acceptance criteria
>
> - [ ] Criterion 1
> - [ ] Criterion 2

&nbsp;

> [!NOTE]
>
> ## Tracking metadata
>
> Use issue metadata in the sidebar instead for core planning:
>
> - Milestone: Target/iteration scope
> - Type: work domain (Governance, Security, CI, Docs, Release, Community etc)
> - Priority: MoSCoW alignment (Must Have ≈ scope MVP)
> - Effort: XS | S | M | L | XL
> - Relationships: Mark known or obvious dependencies/blockers
